Commentary.Commentary: So, that is it from this game! Happy scenes in the Sri Lankan camp as they get their hands on the trophy and pose for the photographs. After a poor 2017, they have started 2018 with a bang. Bangladesh, on the other hand, started the tournament with flying colours but faltered when it mattered the most. Nevertheless, it is now time for both the teams to turn their attention the longest format of the game. They will be locking horns in the first Test in Chittagong on the 31st of January at 0930 local (0330 GMT). Before we leave, you can switch tabs to the on-going final Test between South Africa and India where the Indians are on a roll to salvage some pride. Till then, take care and bye!

Sri Lanka skipper, Dinesh Chandimal, smiles and says they are over the moon as their hard work has paid off. Mentions Bangladesh are very strong at home and that they never underestimated them in their den. Admits it was a very tough wicket to bat on, especially if you are batting second. Reckons the partnership between Tharanga and Dickwella was very crucial. Appreciates the way the debutant, Madushanka bowled. Ends by thanking the selection committee and also Angelo Mathews for all that they have put in.

Man of the Series, Thisara Perera, says they came back strongly after losing the first two games. Mentions it is a good sign that Kusal Mendis is in form. Credits the batsmen and bowlers for their performance today. Informs he is working hard on his bowling with his bowling coach.

Man of the Match, Upul Tharanga, says it was difficult to score on such a wicket. Opines even though you are set, it was difficult to make runs. Adds the first ten overs were very crucial and Suranga Lakmal and Dushmantha Chameera bowled really well to keep things tight.

Bangladesh skipper, Mashrafe Mortaza, says it was a difficult wicket to bat on and that his bowlers did well to restrict Sri Lanka to a respectable total. Admits losing Shakib was a big blow as they need the experienced man in such a crunch game. Reckons all they needed was one good partnership. Appreciates Mahmudullah for the way he batted and showed how to go about on such a wicket. Ends by thanking the fans for the way they have supported them.

Dushmantha Chameera was the pick of the bowlers as he picked up the important wickets of Tamim and Sabbir to give his team an ideal start. Akila Dananjaya did well to put the breaks in between and also broke the vital stand which at once looked like taking the game away from them. Debutant, Madushanka finished things off with a hat-trick on debut which was the icing on the cake. Stay tuned for the presentation...

Chasing 222 was never going to be easy considering the sluggish nature of the wicket and the way Sri Lanka bowled was exceptional. They were very disciplined with the new ball, not giving anything away and picking up three wickets (one being the big one of Tamim Iqbal) in the first Powerplay to dent the hosts to an extent. However, the stand between Rahim and Mahmudullah did bring them back into the game but once the former departed, the wickets started to fall at regular intervals and with Shakib out injured, it was always going to be an uphill task. Mahmudullah did play a fighting knock of 76 but lacked support from the other end and eventually perished.

After winning the toss, Chandimal elected to bat and they put up a fighting total on a pitch that started to crumble as the game progressed. Tharanga crafted his way to a fruitful half-century and was well supported by Dickwella first, and then Chandimal. After his departure, their skipper ensured that he stays for as long as possible to take the score over the 220-run mark. Rubel Hossain bowled really well for Bangladesh as he bagged four wickets.

A fairy tale ending for the Lankans as they have won the Tri-Series with a comprehensive win over the hosts. Not many would have given them a chance after they started off their campaign with two losses, especially the one against Zimbabwe. They now roared back in some style to silence the critics and have their name on the cup. Well played, Sri Lanka.

OUT! In the air... gone! It's a Hat-trick on debut for Shehan Madushanka and he has sealed the deal for the Lankans. He lands it on a length around off, Mahmudullah comes down the track and tries to go over mid off. He gets it off the splice and it's a dolly for Akila Dananjaya in that region. Mahmudullah is the last man walking back after a fighting innings. All smiles on the Lankan faces as they barge towards the bowler to congratulate him. SRI LANKA BEAT BANGLADESH BY 79 RUNS TO WIN THE TRI-SERIES!
The debutant is on a hat-trick. Here he comes steaming in...
Back of a length on off, guided to point.
The batsman has driven it through mid off.
Full and wide outside off, Rahman tries to reach for it but cannot.
The batsman was beaten and missed the line of the delivery.
Full and wide outside off, Rahman tries to put bat to it but gets beaten.
Length outside off, guided down to third man for a run. Interesting, Mahmudullah goes for a run and asks Rahman to face next 5 balls in this over.
Powerplay 3 has been signalled. Five fielders are now allowed outside the circle. Also, Mustafizur Rahman is the last man in as Shakib won't come out to bat.

OUT! Two-in-two for Madushanka! Sri Lanka cruising towards victory! A good pacy delivery, full and on the stumps. Too good for a no. 10 batsman. He tries to swing at it but is beaten by sheer pace. Before he gets his bat down, the ball knocks the off stump back. A golden duck for Hossain and Shehan will be on a hat-trick in his next over.
Rubel Hossain is the next man in.

OUT! Maiden ODI wicket for Madushanka! Not the best delivery but he will be mighty pleased with it. A full toss, a waist height full toss on middle. Mortaza goes for the big slog but does not get anything behind the shot. He hits it flat to mid-wicket where Kusal Mendis takes a sharp catch. Mortaza stands in disbelief as he knows he would have put that ball away 9 out of 10 times but this is the one time he does not. He starts walking back but the umpires ask him to wait as they want to check for the no ball. Replays roll in and the front foot is termed okay. It was touch and go but the umpire rules it in the favour of the bowler. Also the ball is dipping and Mashrafe is given his marching orders. Sri Lanka are now just two wickets away as Shakib won't be batting.
The captain tries to join in the fun with a heave but he mistimes it to mid-wicket.
Nice batting! On a length around off, guided towards point for a quick run.
Goes for another by coming down the track. He swings but connects with thin air. Easy Mahmudullah you have got the boundary you needed, play sensible now.

FOUR! Great way to start the over! They needed this especially after a quiet last over. A short ball on middle, Mahmudullah takes on the challenge of pulling, he connects well and it goes over mid-wicket for a boundary. Two runs more than 80 needed of 65 balls.
Excellent over! Just 2 from it! Mahmudullah pushes the ball to mid on for a run.
A single! Fuller ball on middle, clipped to mid on. The batsmen set off for a run. The fielder there scores a direct hit at the bowler's end but the batsman has made his ground.
Very full this time on off, Mortaza drives it to covers. 4 dots, something is going to happen now it seems.
Shorter in length, Mortaza hops and defends it onto the ground. Three dots to begin with.
Another length ball on off, defended towards point for a run.
A low full toss outside off, Mortaza guides it to point where the fielder fumbles but does not concede a run.
Fuller on middle, Mortaza flicks it through square leg for a run.
Length outside off, Mortaza plays inside the line and is beaten.
Works it around the corner for an easy single.
The batsman has played it towards mid-wicket.
On a length around off, guided down to third man for a run.
Full ball on middle, Mortaza hits it hard down the ground. The mid off fielder does well to run to his right, dive and make a half stop but can't stop the batsmen from taking two.
Shehan Madushanka is brought back on.
Ball hits the batsman low on the pads. One run added to the total. Leg byes signalled by the umpire
Fuller on off, driven through covers for a run.
Back of a length on off, guided to point.
Mashrafe Mortaza walks out to the middle. He needs to play a captain's knock here.

OUT! Oh no no no! A run out, the last thing Bangladesh wanted. Just as this partnership was building, Sri Lanka have been gifted with the breakthrough. Saifuddin taps the length ball towards Asela Gunaratne at short mid-wicket. Mahmudullah straightaway sets off for a run but Saifuddin is ball-watching. He later realizes that Mahmudullah is standing right next to him and shows good awareness by sacrificing his wicket as he tries to make it to the other end. Gunaratne too, shows great awareness as instead of throwing it, he runs towards the stumps and takes the bails off with a dive at the bowler's end. Saifuddin is well short. He takes the long walk back. Bangladesh still need another 95 from 81.
Length around off, guided down to third man for a run.
A full toss to start with on the pads. The batsman flicks it down to fine leg to give Mahmudullah the strike.
Flicks it with the angle towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
Works it with the spin towards square leg for a single.
Down the leg side, Mahmudullah misses the flick. The keeper appeals but the umpire signals a wide.
Driven through the covers by the batsman. They pick up a single.
On the stumps, defended.

Bonus run! Danushka fires it on the pads, Saifuddin tries to clip but misses to get hit on the pads. The ball goes towards short fine leg. The batsmen go for a run. The fielder there scores a direct hit at the non-striker's end but the batsman has made it in. The deflects towards mid on for an overthrow. The umpire signals leg byes.
Floats it up on off, driven back to the bowler.
Bangs it in outside off, Saifuddin guides it down to third man for a run. 10 runs from the over. 103 from 90 now.
Length ball attacking the stumps. Saifuddin keeps it out.
Another single! 9 from the first 4 balls. Length ball around off, guided down to third man for a run.
Sensible batting by Saifuddin as he tucks it through mid-wicket for a single.
Follows it up with a run by guiding it down to third man.
SIX! Mahmudullah is on the charge here! What a shot this is! He comes down the track, gets a length ball which he sends sailing over the long off fence for a biggie.
Suranga Lakmal is back on.
Yes, he does! Quicker on off, Saifuddin tries to defend but gets an inside edge onto his pads.
Tosses it up outside off, driven to covers. 5 dots, can he bowl a maiden?
Another ball angling into the batsman, worked to mid-wicket.
Works it to mid-wicket with the angle.
Flatter on the pads, Saifuddin goes for the flick but misses to get hit on the thigh pad.
Very full on the stumps, Saifuddin jams it out.
Danushka Gunathilaka is into the attack.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Floats it up on off, defended.
Worked with the turn to mid-wicket.
SIX! Enough, says Mahmudullah. Akila tosses this one up on middle, Mahmudullah goes down on one knee and slog sweeps it over the mid-wicket fence. 113 runs needed now.
The batsman gets an inside edge and the ball hits him on the pads.

A big appeal but the umpire stays put! The manner in which the Lankans appealed showed how desperate they are for Mahmudullah's wicket. Dananjaya bowls a googly outside off, it turns back in. Mahmudullah tries to defend but the ball sneaks between the gap between bat and pad and goes to the keeper who takes it on the second attempt. The players put in a loud appeal, Akil has almost started celebrating but the umpire shakes his head.
Fires it down the leg side and the umpire signals a wide.
Back of a length on off, guided to point.
The batsman plays it with an angled bat and guides it to third man. They pick up a single.
Shorter in length on off, Saifuddin guides it down to third man for a run.
Fuller in length outside off, Saifuddin goes after it loosely and gets beaten.

Fifty for Mahmudullah, his 18th in this format. He is fighting a lone battle out there and if Bangladesh are to win it all depends on this man. He will have to make it big from here and stay till the end. He guides the length ball down to third man for a run.
Back of a length on off, Mahmudullah keeps it out.
Dushmantha Chameera is back on.
BEATEN! He is spinning a web around the batsman. Akila tosses it up on off, it turns away sharply. Saifuddin tries to keep it out of the back foot but is beaten.
Punched off the back foot by the batsman.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Gives it a nice loop on off, Mahmudullah pushes it towards cover and sets off for a run. He is sprinting to the other end in search of a second but it is not on.
Flatter on the stumps, it stays low. Mahmudullah does well to get his bat down in time and block it.
Floats it up on off, Mahmudullah defends it.
An off spinner down the leg side. The umpire calls it a wide.
Full and wide outside off, driven to cover-point. 6 runs from the over, a good one for the home side.
A bumper on middle, Saifuddin ducks under it.
Shortish outside off, cut through the same region but this time for one.
FOUR! They need to do this quite often now. A short ball outside off, Mahmudullah slashes at it and it goes through backward point. The fielder from third man gives it a chase, dives but all in vain.
Fullish on off, stroked to covers.
Fuller outside off, driven through covers for a single.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Drags his length back on middle, Saifuddin pulls it down to long on to get off the mark.
Tosses it up on middle, turning away. Saifuddin lunges forward and blocks it.
Flighted ball on off, driven to covers.
Floats it up on off, the batsman defends it off the front foot.
Mohammad Saifuddin walks out to the middle.

OUT! GONE! A very soft dismissal and Bangladesh now have half the side back in the hut. Akila tosses it up outside off, turns back in. Hasan tries to flick but closes the face of the bat early. He gets a leading edge which lobs towards the bowler who accepts the simplest of catches. Akila gets his second and now Bangladesh are staring down the barrel. They require another 132 from 131 balls.
Another tight over by Perera! This will keep building the pressure on Bangladesh. Perera lands it on a length around off, the batsman lets it be.

A huge appeal but only by the bowler! A length ball outside off, it zips off the surface. Mahmudullah tries to guide it down but does not connect. The bowler appeals but seeing no support from anybody he pulls out.
In the air.. but on the bounce to the fielder. A bumper on middle, pulled on the bounce to fine leg for a run.
This is excellent bowling, giving nothing away. A length ball around off, Hasan blocks it.
The batsman flicks it away with a wristy shot. They pick up a single.
Fullish on off, driven down to mid off.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Flighted ball on off, turning back in. It goes off the inner half towards short leg.
Flatter on the pads, flicked around the corner for a run.
Tosses it up on middle, Mahmudullah works it towards the leg side.
Floats it up on off, Mahmudullah lunges forward and defends it.
Gives it air on off, Hasan drives it down to long on to rotate strike.
Dot to finish a tight over! On a length around off, Mahmudullah defends it solidly.
Back of a length on off, defended to covers.
Fuller outside off, comes in late. Mahmudullah tries to drive it through the off side but is beaten by the inswing.
Short ball on middle, Hasan goes for the pull, he times it well but straight to fine leg for a run.
Errs in line and bowls it on the pads, Mahmudullah works it down to fine leg for a single.

On  a length around off, tailing back in. Mahmudullah does really well to keep it out as that swung in late. We saw the Bangladesh bowlers doing this and now the Sri Lankan bowlers are trying the same.
Goes back and punches it to the man at short mid-wicket. Just two off this over. Good one from Akila Dananjaya again.
Bowls the off break, it comes back in from outside off, Hasan does well to defend it off the back foot.
Mahmudullah works it with soft hands towards square leg and calls through for a quick single.
Loops it up around middle, it turns towards off and stays low too. Mahmudullah crouches to keep it out.
Gets forward and across and works it towards short mid-wicket.
Flighted delivery outside off, milked down to long on for a single.
Another bumper this time on off, Mahmudullah arches back to let Chandimal collect it. Just 3 runs from the last two overs.
A well-directed bouncer on middle and leg, the batsman ducks.
Stays deep in the crease and turns it through square leg for a single.
Gets forward and taps this length ball towards the point fielder.
Fuller in length on off, pushed towards cover for one.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Mehidy flicks it straight to the man at short mid-wicket. Beautiful over, probably the game-changing one.
Hangs back to a flatter one and punches it back to Akila.
Mehidy Hasan is the new man in.

OUT! Mushfiqur Rahim departs! Akila Dananjaya with a vital breakthrough here. We saw Chandimal having a word with his team after the last ball of the previous over and look what it has done. He is delighted and so are the Lankans. Akila tosses it up around middle, it's the googly. Rahim gets down on one knee to sweep but it takes the gloves and lobs towards short fine leg where Upul Tharanga accepts it gleefully. The 58-run stand comes to an end and Bangladesh need another 142 to win.
Gets down to play the reverse sweep but it goes off the gloves and on the bounce to short third man.
The batsman has flicked the ball off his pads. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Floated delivery on middle and leg, Mahmudullah misses his tuck and is hit on the thigh.

Chandimal is seen having a word with his team after the previous over. He is standing in the middle while his team surrounds him. Maybe, he's pushing his troops with encouraging words. I am not good at lip-reader, but it seems like he is saying, a wicket and we are back into this...
Rahim flicks it straight to the man at short mid-wicket.
Good length delivery, moving away after pitching, Rahim stays back to clip but misses to get hit on the pads. An appeal to which the umpire pays no heed.
Fuller and attacking the stumps, wristed along the ground towards short mid-wicket.
Tad short and angling in. Tucked off the inner half towards mid-wicket. Rahim wants the run and they get it in the end.
Rahim pats it in front of point and calls through for a brisk single.
Starts his new spell with a back of a length delivery, punched to sweeper cover for a single.
Thisara Perera is back into the attack.
Full toss, dipping in, driven down to long on to keep strike.
Flicked against the turn through square leg for a single.

NOT OUT! Pitching outside leg! Rahim will live on! Credit to Mahmudullah for asking him to take the review! Tossed up leg, Rahim gets down to sweep but the ball pitches and turns in to strike him on the pads. Akila pleads in an appeal and the umpire raises his finger after a while. The non-striker and the batter have a word and eventually opt for the DRS! Ball Tracker shows it's pitching outside leg and that is it.
Big, big moment in the game. Rahim misses one to get rapped on the pads. The umpire rules it out. He has a chat with his partner and opts for the DRS. Where is it pitching?

Chance of a run out! Mahmudullah cuts it towards deep point and sets off. Rahim wants another but seeing Perera charging to the ball, he partner sends him back. The Bangla keeper his halfway down the track but much to his delight, Thisara fails to release the ball.
The batsman has flicked the ball off his pads. One run added to the total.
Leans ahead and defends it into the ground.

FOUR! The 50-run stand comes up! These two have done really well to bring the chase back on track. Madushanka strays one down the leg side, Mahmudullah helps it on its away with a tickle to send it across the fine leg fence. Another 150 runs needed for the hosts to win.
Good single! Length delivery outside off, Rahim taps it towards cover and scampers through for one.
Uses the pace and width and steers it square of the wicket on the off side for a single.
Comes forward to a length delivery and defends it down.
Looks to tap and run but gets an inside edge on the pads and the bowler is quick to get to the ball to deny them the single.
Short and it doesn't rise, punched by crouching a touch to sweeper cover for a single.
Flatter one on middle and leg, flicked towards square leg for one.
Loopy delivery around middle and leg, swept through backward square leg for a single.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Goes back and with the spin, he pushes it to point.

NOT OUT! Nothing on Ultra Edge! The crowd go bonkers! Akila with a loopy leg break, it lands and spins away to beat the forward defense of Mahmudullah. Chandimal takes it and he reckons that he heard a sound. After a talk with his mates, he signals for the DRS. Ultra Edge spots no spike as the ball passes the bat. The on-field call stays as it as and with the Sri Lanka lose a review.
Was there an edge? Chandimal and Dananjaya certainly feel so. And after having a mid-pitch chat, Sri Lanka take the review...
Flighted delivery outside off, Mahmudullah lunges forward in defense.
It's a maiden! On a length and in the channel on off, Rahim shows a straight bat.
On middle and leg, worked with soft hands towards short mid-wicket. Good over  so far.
Fuller in length and just outside off, blocked back to the bowler.
Comes forward and solidly defends it down.
Good length delivery, angling in, Rahim looks to flick it but gets a soft leading edge towards cover.
Beaten! Lands it on a length and it shapes away a touch, Rahim tries to push it towards the off side but the ball just whizzes past the outside edge of his bat.

Mahmudullah knows he has missed out on that one! Dananjaya slips out a full toss down the leg side, the batsman gets down to help it away but hits it straight to the man at short fine leg and shakes his head.
Gets a faint tickle down to fine leg for a couple.
Quicker through the air outside off, mistimed towards the same region.
Flighted ball outside off, pushed into the cover region.

SIX! Down the track and bang! What a meaty blow! Akila floats it up around off, Mahmudullah skips down the track, meet the pitch of the delivery and smokes it straight back down the ground for a maximum. Clean strike!
Starts with a tossed up ball around middle and leg, Rahim nudges it towards short fine leg and gets to the other end.
Time for spin as Akila Dananjaya comes on to bowl.
Gets away with that one! This was sprayed wider outside off again, Mahmudullah lets it be. The umpire doesn't call it a wide.
Fuller and slower in pace, outside off, Mahmudullah looks to drive but gets beaten.
Wide! Short ball, rises off the deck, the batsman is quick to sit under it.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
Wide! Slower and wider outside off, Mahmudullah throws his bat at it but fails to get any wood on it.
Back of a length delivery outside off, slapped towards point where the fielder dives to his left but fails to stop. The ball goes through his fingers towards third man and they take one.
Short on middle, Rahim mistimes his pull towards short mid-wicket.
Good length delivery on middle, tucked by shuffling a bit towards the leg side.

FOUR! Edgyyyy! Good over for Bangladesh, 11 off it! Perera keeps it on a length outside off, Mahmudullah pokes at it but gets an outside edge past the vacant slip cordon for a boundary. 50 comes up for the hosts. They are slowly getting a move on.
Ahead of a length on off, pushed towards the man at mid off.
On the pads again, deflected down to fine leg for just a single.
Two again! Good length delivery outside, this time it's cracked through the off side. In the gap at cover and they run a couple. 6 off the first three balls.
Perera sprays it on the pads again, Mushfiqur flicks it through square leg and collects another brace.
Nicely done! Rahim walks across to a full length delivery on the pads and flicks it through the gap at mid-wicket to bag a double to his name.

Good stop! Good length delivery, shaping away late and squares the batsman up. Mahmudullah gets an edge which goes on the bounce towards wide slip fielder who dives to his right to collect it with his one hand. He then returns a throw at the striker's end and hits as well. Lovely stuff!
Short and offers a bit of width, Mahmudullah rises on his toes and hits it over backward point. The man in the deep is fine which allows the pair to take a brace.
Taps this back of a length delivery towards point.
A bit too straight, clipped down to fine leg for one.

Lovely stop, Gunathilaka! Saved just a run but what commitment. Tells us how deadly are the Lankans. Madushanka overpitches it on off, Mahmudullah leans ahead and caresses it through the gap at cover. Danushka races after that one, dives and flicks the ball to keep it in play. They check if he has made contact with the ball when he touched the ropes or not. He didn't. Three runs taken.
The debutant is right on the money. Starts off with a length delivery on the stumps, watchfully kept out by Mahmudullah.
The debutant, Shehan Madushanka is into the attack.
On a length around off, defeded to point.
The batsman has driven it through mid off.
Fullish on off, Mahmudullah drives it through covers for a run.
Back to bowling length around off, the batsman defends it.

FOUR! Up and over! That was in the air but away from the fielder. Short and width on offer outside off, Mahmudullah cuts it over the point fielder. The third man fielder can't get to it and the ball crosses the fence.
On a length around off, guided towards point.
Shortish ball outside off, the batsman goes for the pull but misses.
Thisara Perera is into the attack.
Bouncer! The batsman does well to evade it.
Another short ball, the batsman ducks.
Errs in line and bowls it on the pads, too easy for Mahmudullah as he flicks it fine down to fine leg for a run.
A bouncer on middle, ducked under.
Length ball around off, pushed to mid on.

Slightly short and wider on off, Rahim looks to run it down towards third man but finds the widish slip fielder. The ball goes on the bounce to Kusal Mendis there who fails to stop it cleanly. Parries it towards third man before hunting it down. Two added to the total.
Wide outside off, tempting line from Lakmal but Rahim resists. He lifts his bat to make a leave.
Length delivery, curling back in a bit, Rahim looks to work it away with the angle but gets an inside edge on the pads.
Fuller and fired outside off, Mushfiqur is happy to shoulder his arm.
Drops it a tad short on middle and off, Rahim hangs back in defense.
Fuller in length and around off, driven back to the bowler.
End of Powerplay 1. Now Sri Lanka can have an extra man outside the circle till the 40th over.
Short again, in the zone outside off, the batsman rides the bounce as he pushes it to point.

FOUR! Edged and through! A streaky way to get off the mark! Short ball, in the corridor of uncertainty, Mahmudullah stays back and at the last moment hangs his bat out to it. Much to his delight, the ball takes the edge but flies right between the keeper and the wide slip fielder. Races down to the third man fence then.
The batsman chooses to leave the ball outside his off stump.
Shortish of a good length, Mahmudullah hops back to tuck it away.
Mahmudullah strides out next at no. 5.

OUT! Straight to the man! Bangladesh lose another. Chameera is up and running as he gets his second. Pindrop silence in the crowd for the obvious reason. Hits the deck hard does Chameera, it gets big on Sabbir Rahman who doesn't hold back. Swivels to pull it away but mistimes it towards short mid-wicket where Asela Gunaratne takes a sharp catch. Sri Lanka continue to chip away at the wickets.
Length ball on middle and leg, tucked towards the leg side. Looks for the single which is not on.

FOUR! Easily done! A bit too straight from Lakmal and Rahim makes the most of it. Gets a fuller ball on middle and leg, Mushfiqur Rahim walks across and flicks it neatly through mid-wicket to pick up a boundary. The little man gets off the mark.
Touch fuller on off, blocked down solidly.
Back of a length outside off, Rahman dabs it down towards third man for a single.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Fuller on off, Rahim looks to defend but gets an inside edge on the pads.
Mushfiqur Rahim is the new man in.

OUT! Bull's eye from Thisara Perera! Superb fielding effort from the all-rounder. Bangladesh are going nowhere in the run chase. Lakmal keeps it on a length outside off, Mohammad Mithun punches it towards mid off and takes on the fielder there. Perera charges in, picks the ball up with his right hand and releases to take the stumps down at the bowler's end. Mithun drags his bat to get back in but seems to be a goner. They refer it upstairs and replays show the opener is well short of his ground.
Direct hit from Perera. Sri Lanka feel that they have got their man. The body language of Mithun suggests that he is a goner. Let's wait and find out...
Bouncer! The batsman ducks in time to let that one go over him.
Good ball! Dushmantha bowls a bumper on middle and off, Sabbir half-ducks under it.

Overthrow! Back of a length ball outside off, punched off the back foot towards cover. The fielder there has a needless shy at the bowler's end and it hits the stumps. The ball deflects towards mid-wicket and the batsmen cross over.

That beats everyone! Slower short ball outside off, Rahman goes for the pull but misses it. The ball sneaks under his bat and goes on the bounce to the keeper who fumbles. The man from first slip chases it down as the batsmen take a bye.
Fractionally short and served just outside off, Mithun taps it in front of point and sets off. Gunathilaka has a shy at the striker's end but misses. In fact, it hits Sabbir on the left arm.
Rahman opens his account! Uses the pace and runs it down to third man to get to the other end.
Wide! Tries to attack the stumps but ends up spraying it down the leg side. Sabbir moves inside the line to clip but misses it.
Make it 6! A maiden for Lakmal! Tidy stuff from the ace-pacer! He bowls a short ball on off, played off the back foot towards the point fielder.
Fuller and attacking the stumps, wristed towards the man at short mid-wicket. 5 dots in a row!
Shortish outside off, punched towards the point fielder.
Takes a stride forward to this length ball and stabs it out towards cover.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Fuller ball on off, blocked solidly off the front foot.
Length ball on middle and leg, Mithun misses his clip as the ball goes off the pads towards fine leg. A leg bye taken. Superb over from Chameera.
Short and angling in, MM misses his tuck and gets hit on the pads.

Edgeddddd but it drops short! Chameera is making things happen here. Bowls a length delivery, a bit shorter in length and in the channel of uncertainty. Mithun is in two minds whether to leave it alone or go after it. By the time he pulls his bat out, the ball takes the outer edge and dips just in front of the second slip fielder who collects it on the bounce. Dushmantha has his tail up.
Shakib Al Hasan isn't deemed fit enough to walk out and hence Sabbir Rahman is in at no. 3.

OUT! Top edge and taken this time! Dangerous Tamim walks back and Sri Lanka draw first blood. The joy on their faces tells us how big the wicket it is. Tamim survived a chance on the previous ball and fails to make it count. Chameera digs in a short ball, bends his back at this to get some extra zip and bounce. The southpaw is hurried by that and still goes on with his pull shot. A big top edge is induced and Akila Dananjaya settles under it at mid on. Bangladesh lose their mainstay and need 211 to win.
Tamim Iqbal immediately wants to change his bat.

Dropped off his own bowling! Big, big moment in the game this could be. That should have been plucked. Hurls it on a length, slants it away outside off does Chameera. Tamim runs out of patience and skips down the track to hit big. Ends up getting it off the toe-end of the bat back to the bowler who was wrong footed. The ball comes to his right and he has to dive. Gets both his hands to it but fails to hold on. Iqbal survives a big scare.

Chameera bangs in a short one on middle and off, Tamim likes the length and with his one leg up in the air, tries to pull it away. Some extra zip off the surface gets the better of him and he gets beaten all ends up.
Keeps it a touch short, it comes back in, Mithun looks to steer it away but ends up chopping it on the pitch.
Stays right behind the line of this one and offers another solid defense.
Goes fuller does Suranga, pushed off the front foot back to the bowler off the inner half.
Shortish again but this time the line is correct. It's outside off, defended solidly.

SIX! That should break the shackles! Taking on the best opposition bowler isn't an easy task! Lakmal drops it short on middle and leg, Mohammad Mithun stands and pulls it with authority over backward square leg for a maximum. The crowd roars in joy.
Good length ball, coming back in from around off, Mithun tries to tuck it away but the ball comes slowly off the surface, takes the leading edge and falls short of the man at cover.
Back of a length delivery on middle and off, Iqbal covers the line and stabs it out.
Bangs in a short one on the leg stump, it's a well-directed one too. Tamim is quick to duck under that one.
Short and slanting away a touch, dabbed by hopping a bit towards point.
Pitches it right up there, Tamim leans forward and drives it straight to the cover fielder.
Slightly fuller and angling in on middle, Mithun wrists it towards short mid-wicket and scampers through for a single.
Edgyyy! Chameera hurls it full and wide on off, Tamim leans forward to drive but gets it off the outer edge through point for a single.
Fullish on off, driven down to mid off. End of another tight over.
Hits the length hard on off, it jags back in after pitching. Mithun gets an inside edge onto his pads.
On a length around off, defended solidly.
Fullish on off, Tamim gets it off the inner half through mid-wicket for a run.
Fuller in length on middle, Tamim gets a soft leading edge to point.
Length ball outside off, Iqbal again plays inside the line and lets it go.
Good length around off, Iqbal tries to defend but it goes off the inner half towards mid-wicket for a quick run. Good bowling by Sri Lanka, two tight overs to being with.
Excellent save at point! A short ball outside off, Mithun punches it towards point. Gunathilaka there, dives to his left and makes a half stop. The batsmen do get a single though.
Shorter in length on middle, Mithun ducks under it.
Another length delivery outside off, Mithun does not fiddle with it.
Another full ball swinging away. Mithun makes a leave.
Length ball outside off, Mithun leaves it.
Dushmantha Chameera to bowl from the other end.
Full and wide outside off, Iqbal once again keeps his eyes on the ball and leaves it. A watchful start by Tamim.
Similar delivery, this time Tamim plays inside the line and lets it be.
Better! Excellent delivery! A length around off, shapes away a touch. Tamim pushes at it tentatively but gets beaten.
Another ball outside off, Iqbal lets it be.
Wide outside off, Iqbal makes a watchful leave.
Starts off with a shorter in length delivery, aimed at the rib cage of the batsmen. He tucks it away to square leg.

We are back for the chase! It will be interesting to see how Bangladesh fare in the final. Will the pressure get the better of them? Remains to be seen. Tamim Iqbal and Mohammad Mithun will open the innings. Suranga Lakmal will open the bowling for Lanka. Here we go...
